finalText:
All objectives verified complete.

## Final Report

**1. DONE** — Ticket created: reference **RD-1015**, title **"s4bp RD Bench Ticket"**, customer "Bench Customer", initial status Draft. Confirmed appearing at the top of the tickets list (count went 13 → 14).

**2. DONE** — Part **"s4bp RD Part A"** added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed **price: $125.00** (ticket total $125.00).

**3. DONE** — Part **"s4bp RD Part B"** added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed **price: $250.00** (ticket total $375.00).

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost changed 100 → 150 (markup kept at 25%). App-computed **price afterwards: $187.50** (ticket total $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00).

**5. DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned.** The exact refusal message on the first attempt was:
> `Ticket is not ready Part "s4bp RD Part A" has no supplier Part "s4bp RD Part B" has no supplier`

I satisfied it by editing each part and entering the supplier **"Acme Supply"** in the Supplier field (a free-text input, not a dropdown — there is no supplier list in the app). After both parts had suppliers, "Mark Ready" succeeded with no error; status displayed as **Ready** and the action buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted (each confirmed via the dialog "Delete the part \"…\" from this ticket? This cannot be undone."). Parts table now shows the empty state **"No parts on this ticket yet."** Ticket then archived via "Archive ticket" (confirmation: *"Archive ticket RD-1015? This will hide it from the default ticket list."*). Final verification: RD-1015 shows an **"Archived"** badge with status **Ready**, 0 parts, and neither "s4bp RD Part A" nor "s4bp RD Part B" appears anywhere on the page. It is absent from the default tickets list (13 tickets, no RD-1015) and visible only with "Show archived" ticked — nothing from this run remains active.
